value.rationale: Infinitesimal symmetries of nonassociative Alexander quandle algebras are reduced from a full quadratic Leibniz system to a character-indexed sparse equation for every finite Latin Alexander quandle, with a structural abelianity theorem. The exact sixth-root criterion exposes natural non-dihedral positive-dimensional families, first at seven elements, while earlier odd dihedral cases are rigid. This is motivated structure, not a mere table recomputation.
